title: Why There Is No Multiverse
arguments: Kolmogorov: multiverse needs >1643 extra bits vs W(3,3) 21-bit seed
Bootstrap uniqueness: F(W(3,3))=W(3,3) has no continuous family of solutions
No branching: Aut(W(3,3)) acts on single register; superposition = orbit exploration
conclusion: No multiverse. One computation. It selected itself.
